discoveries.title: Minimal coexponential obstruction in Set
discoveries.summary: No representable coexponential for |Y|=2, |A|=2 (smallest found in scan).

evidence.reason: cardinality mismatch: |Hom(C,Z)| = |Z|^|C| cannot match |Hom(Y,A+Z)| = (|A|+|Z|)^|Y| for all Z unless trivial constants.

discoveries.significance: Formal dual to coproduct is empty already for 2-element probes.

discoveries.title: Exponential vs polynomial growth in |Z|
discoveries.summary: cardinality mismatch: |Hom(C,Z)| = |Z|^|C| cannot match |Hom(Y,A+Z)| = (|A|+|Z|)^|Y| for all Z unless trivial constants.
discoveries.significance: No fixed finite C can represent the coproduct functor for all Z.

discoveries.title: Strict certification boundary (2-block Fisher toy)
discoveries.summary: Separable factorization is strictly certified for f <~ 0.181; fails above (epsilon or gap vs Phi).
discoveries.significance: Operational epsilon_0 band aligns with coupling ~0.10–0.15 in this toy.

discoveries.title: Tightest certified gap vs Phi(epsilon)
discoveries.summary: Among certified couplings, max gap/Phi ~ 0.908 at f=0.07 (bound is conservative elsewhere).
discoveries.significance: Phi is rarely tight; certification fails mainly via epsilon_0, not gap alone.

discoveries.title: face_bowl breaks vertex localization
discoveries.summary: Interior (lambda,sigma) face wins over corners from strength ~0.188 (grid gain 0.0018).
discoveries.significance: Theorem 1 hypotheses fail; extremal search alone is unsound.

discoveries.title: Nonlinear interaction localization map
discoveries.summary: Grid reference beats vertex-only search in 9 cases: structural (6): trig@0.5, trig@1.0, trig@1.5, face_bowl@0.5; cross-block coupling (3): bilinear@0.5, bilinear@1.0, bilinear@1.5.
discoveries.significance: face_bowl/trig/softplus break axis quasiconvexity; strong bilinear/triple violate separate monotonicity — Theorem 1 does not apply.

discoveries.title: Hypersurface vertex invariant under Fisher coupling
discoveries.summary: Vertex probe stays at (1,0,2,3) for all tested f (confirmed).
discoveries.significance: Coupling affects separable gap, not corner argmax on this box.

discoveries.title: Fisher top-k pruning sensitivity
discoveries.summary: top_k=1 loses 0.0000 vs full probe; top_k=4 loses 0.0000 (CCC corner value 7.0000).
discoveries.significance: Theorem 3 pruning is safe only when marginals rank the true pair in top-k.

discoveries.title: Decomposition strategy phase transitions
discoveries.summary: 2 strategy changes along coupling sweep; first JOINT_SOLVE near epsilon=0.3535533905932738.
discoveries.significance: Design rules R1–R5 are discrete phases, not a smooth continuum.

discoveries.title: CCC corner beats coexponential shadow
discoveries.summary: Global diagram max at PRODUCT_EXPONENTIAL (U=3.000); coproduct blocks still peak at inhabited corners.
discoveries.significance: Operational substitute aligns with product/exp, not empty coexp.

formal_proofs.label: Proposition A.1
formal_proofs.title: Minimal non-degenerate obstruction
formal_proofs.statement: No such C exists for (|Y|, |A|) = (2, 2). More generally, for |Y| >= 1 and |A| >= 1 the functor Z ↦ |Hom(Y, A ⊔ Z)| = (|A|+|Z|)^{|Y|} cannot be naturally isomorphic to Z ↦ |Z|^{|C|} for any fixed finite |C|.
hypotheses: Sought: object C and natural isomorphism Hom(C, Z) ≅ Hom(Y, A ⊔ Z) for all finite Z.

formal_proofs.label: Lemma A.2
formal_proofs.title: Growth-rate separation
formal_proofs.statement: For fixed y, a >= 1 and any candidate |C|=c, the ratio ρ(z) = |Hom(Y,A⊔Z)| / |Hom(C,Z)| = (a+z)^y / z^c is strictly increasing in z for z large enough; hence no universal C works on an unbounded Z probe.

formal_proofs.label: Proposition B.1
formal_proofs.title: Certification threshold in the toy Fisher model
formal_proofs.statement: There exists a coupling threshold f* in (0, 0.35) such that strict certification holds for all f < f* and fails for all f > f* in the bisection probe. Failure is driven primarily by epsilon > epsilon_0, not by gap > Phi alone.
hypotheses: 2-block Fisher layout, quadratic joint objective, default linear term and box.
Certificate: gap_joint_sep <= Phi(epsilon) and epsilon <= epsilon_0 (Theorem 2).

formal_proofs.label: Lemma B.2
formal_proofs.title: Conservatism of Phi(epsilon)
formal_proofs.statement: Whenever strict certification holds, gap / Phi(epsilon) <= 1. In the scanned coupling grid the supremum of this ratio among certified runs is strictly less than 1 (empirically ~0.91), so Phi is rarely tight.

formal_proofs.label: Theorem C.1 (Counterexample)
formal_proofs.title: face_bowl violates vertex localization
formal_proofs.statement: For s = 0, Theorem 1 applies and max C is on ext(H). There exists s* > 0 such that for all s >= s* the maximizer on the (lambda,sigma)-face is in the relative interior of [0,1]^2, hence some global maximizer is not in ext(H).
hypotheses: Box H = [0,1]^2 x [0,2] x [0,3] for (lambda, sigma, b, k).

formal_proofs.label: Proposition C.2
formal_proofs.title: Classification of localization failure
formal_proofs.statement: (i) If interaction is trig or face_bowl with sufficient strength, Theorem 1 hypotheses fail (non-quasiconvex / interior face optimum). (ii) If interaction is bilinear with strength s on lam*sigma + b*k, separate monotonicity in block coordinates fails; Theorem 1 does not apply. (iii) triple at tested strengths remains vertex-local on the coarse grid probe.

formal_proofs.label: Lemma D.1
formal_proofs.title: Hypersurface argmax decouples from Fisher coupling
formal_proofs.statement: The VertexProbeAlgorithm argmax theta* in ext(H) for the default hypersurface is independent of Fisher coupling parameter f in the coupled quadratic model, as long as probe construction uses only C_0 marginals.
hypotheses: Theorem 1 hypotheses for base hypersurface C_0 on box H.
VertexProbe scores only C_0 (marginals of g,h,r), not Fisher-quadratic correction.

formal_proofs.label: Lemma E.1
formal_proofs.title: Soundness of Fisher top-k pruning
formal_proofs.statement: If the true optimal pair (v_A*, v_B*) lies in the top-k marginal sets, FisherPrunedVertexSearch returns the same value as full vertex probe. If k=1 but the true pair is not top-1 on both marginals, the pruned search can be suboptimal.

formal_proofs.label: Proposition F.1
formal_proofs.title: Piecewise design-rule phases
formal_proofs.statement: The map epsilon ↦ DecompositionStrategy is piecewise constant with finitely many thresholds. Along the coupling sweep, strategy changes occur when epsilon crosses epsilon_low or epsilon_high bands.

formal_proofs.label: Proposition G.1
formal_proofs.title: CCC corner dominates coexponential shadow
formal_proofs.statement: The global maximizer of understanding on ext(P) is Vertex.PRODUCT_EXPONENTIAL, not COPRODUCT_COEXPONENTIAL. Per-coproduct-block probes also avoid the empty coexponential shadow when cross_naturality is feasible.
hypotheses: ConceptualPolytope with coexp_shadow_penalty > 0 on coproduct_coexp coordinate.
